title: Level 9: Gradle, Build Engineering, and CI/CD
description: Engineer predictable Android builds through Gradle lifecycle and lazy task models, Android variants and dependency governance, composable tested convention plugins, and measured cache-correct performance.
plannedTopics: Gradle initialization, configuration and execution, task DAGs, Providers, inputs and outputs, incremental work, Kotlin DSL, services and workers
Android source sets, build types, flavours, variant-aware resolution, catalogues, BOMs, locking, verification and Android Components
Convention plugins, buildSrc versus included builds, typed extensions, code generation, TestKit and a composable convention suite
Build measurement, configuration and build caches, parallel critical paths, KSP incrementality, ABI analysis and CI cache correctness
Week 39: signed release artifacts, App Bundles, R8 outputs, release tracks, CI/CD security and the completed convention-plugin project

project.title: Convention Plugin Build
project.summary: Create tested application, library, Compose, testing, coverage, and static-analysis conventions for a scalable Android build.
